entities.summary: Munarbek Seiitbek Uulu is a Kyrgyzstani boxer. He competed in the 2024 Paris Olympics in the men's 57 kg weight division and reached the semifinals after defeating Luiz Gabriel Oliveira and Jahmal Harvey.
